Bundled third-party assets

- MediaPipe Tasks Vision JavaScript package, @mediapipe/tasks-vision 1.1.1

  License: Apache License 2.0
- MediaPipe Pose Landmarker Lite float16 model

The app runs pose inference locally. Its Content Security Policy limits connections to the local app server and blob URLs.
